name: Chain Transfer

chains.label: Chains
chains.desc: How many chain strands lift between the rollers. More strands spread the load, so a small or floppy carton is less likely to sag between them.

distance.label: Lane spacing (m)
distance.desc: Centre-to-centre gap between chain strands. Together with the strand count this sets how wide the transfer reaches across the host bed.

laneLength.label: Lane length (m)
laneLength.desc: How far each strand runs in the transfer direction - the stroke available to push product off the main line.

fpmUnits.label: PLC speed in FPM
fpmUnits.desc: The unit the PLC commands this conveyor in. On: feet per minute. Off: metres per second. The speed tag is a REAL either way, so switching changes what its value means and never how the program declares it. Set by the scene Units (Scene Properties), which switch every conveyor together, so the Inspector does not show it. A conveyor saved before this switch existed is in metres per second.

speedFpm.label: Speed
speedFpm.desc: Surface speed in feet per minute. Negative runs it backwards. A program can command this through the FPM speed tag below.

speed.label: Speed
speed.desc: How fast the chains carry product sideways once raised. Negative sends it the other way.

raised.label: Raised (divert)
raised.desc: Lift the chains above the roller line to take the load off the main lane and drive it sideways. This is the state it starts in; Use cycles it by hand. While a program drives the pop-up tag below, that program owns it instead.

raiseTime.label: Pop-up time (s)
raiseTime.desc: How long the chains take to rise or drop. A program must wait this out before running the transfer, and a quicker pop-up throws the load harder: at the default a packed row moves about 20 mm, and below about 0.07 s it loses its packing.

speedTag.label: Speed tag
speedTag.desc: The program commands chain speed here, replacing the Speed field above. Careful: once BOUND this takes over even if no program drives it, and an undriven tag reads 0.

speedFpmTag.label: Speed tag
speedFpmTag.desc: The program commands surface speed here in feet per minute, replacing the Speed field above, which then shows the live value read-only. Once BOUND this takes over even if no program writes it, so an unwritten tag holds the conveyor at 0.

popupTag.label: Pop-up tag (true = divert)
popupTag.desc: Raise the chains from the program. While a program drives this tag it OWNS the transfer, so a hand Use in pilot mode is refused with "In auto - PLC controlled".
